summary: Bump the changelog-derived project version from 0.4.4 to 0.4.5 and move the installer disk-column resize and disk-serial fixes (BUG-0529, BUG-0530) under the new heading. API impact: none — no operation is introduced or changed, so no x-introduced-version stamp moves.

guide.reason: Working-version stamps on install, updates, publish and pool guide pages move to 0.4.5; operator workflows unchanged.

api.reason: Installer-only fixes ship in 0.4.5; no Controller or Core operation is introduced or changed, so the generated API reference keeps its existing version stamps.

roadmap.reason: Release metadata only; phase gates unchanged.

state.reason: No durable product setting or resource is introduced.

verification.method: python3 scripts/release-version.py --current --format both and --tag v0.4.5 return 0.4.5; python3 -m unittest tests.test_release_version; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_repository_privacy.py.
